# Hanumat (hanumat.life)

> Free, ad-free digital mandir — Hanuman, Shiva, Maa Kali. English default; Hindi one tap.

## What this site is
A quiet digital temple (PWA) for devotees worldwide. Path Studio: mula, IAST (Roman letters), Hindi & English meaning, japa, parayan, galleries. No ads, no accounts, no trackers.

## Primary offerings
- Hanuman Chalisa (text, IAST, meanings) — Tuesday path
- Sundar Kand (Ramcharitmanas) and Valmiki Sundarakanda
- Bhagavad Gita (18 adhyaya) — Path Studio, Ekadashi path
- Household canon: Gayatri, Ganesha, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Guru, Krishna, Achyutashtakam, Vishnu names doorway
- Shivayatan: Lingashtakam, Om Namah Shivaya, Mahamrityunjaya, Rudrashtakam, Shiva manasa puja
- Kalika Dham: Kalika Ashtakam, Adya Stotram, Kali Gayatri, Durga Saptashloki (no Karpuradi, no unverified Kali Chalisa)
- Household panchang (IST, approximate tithi) — courtyard + calendar; local printed panchang wins; no kundali
- Japa mala per deity, parayan 7/9/21/40, print/PDF
- 108 folk leela paintings per dham
- Locales: English (en, default), Hindi (hi)

## Important disclaimers (always true)
- Meanings are provisional / owner-responsible; not scholarly ṭīkā.
- Mūla collated from public recensions; no Gita Press digital license is claimed.
- No user accounts, no ads, no paid puja, no astrology upsells.
